description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pyke''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Phantom''. '''Pyke''' is [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] while the ''Phantom'' is active.
description.text: Active: Pyke dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a Phantom. Pyke is ghosted while the Phantom is active.

description2.raw: After 1 second, the ''Phantom'' homes back to '''Pyke''' to [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for 1.25 (+ 0.1 per 10 Lethality) seconds. Enemy champions hit also take physical damage.
description2.text: After 1 second, the Phantom homes back to Pyke to stun enemies around it and those it passes through along the way for 1.25 (+ 0.1 per 10 Lethality) seconds. Enemy champions hit also take physical damage.

leveling2.raw:
'''Physical Damage:'''
100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 (+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * The [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] distance can be extended to up to 900 units (estimated) when targeting across terrain. * Like most [[missiles|projectiles]], the flying ''Phantom'' cannot hit targets whose [[File:Range center.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Centered range]] [[:Range|center]] is behind the position it originates at or beyond the position it catches up to '''Pyke''' at, but the spell ''can'' hit targets behind its origin as long as their [[File:Range model.png|20px|link=Range|An icon representing the keyword Edge range]] [[:Range|hitbox radius]] overlaps with the original unit ''Phantom's'' 110-radius check at the end of its lifespan.
notes.text:
The dash distance can be extended to up to 900 units (estimated) when targeting across terrain.
Like most projectiles, the flying Phantom cannot hit targets whose center is behind the position it originates at or beyond the position it catches up to Pyke at, but the spell can hit targets behind its origin as long as their hitbox radius overlaps with the original unit Phantom's 110-radius check at the end of its lifespan.
